target.title: Support Loom share URLs in transcript extraction
target.body:
## Problem

`summarize` currently does not extract transcripts from Loom share URLs.

Example:

```bash
summarize "https://www.loom.com/share/ef3224a48a084371bd6d766ee81f083f" --extract --video-mode transcript --json
```

Current behavior: Summarize extracts the Loom page summary/metadata, but no transcript. The JSON reports:

```json
"transcriptMetadata": {
  "provider": "generic",
  "reason": "not_implemented"
}
```

## Why this should work

`yt-dlp` already supports public Loom share URLs. A metadata-only probe resolves the URL with:

- `extractor: "loom"`
- duration and chapters
- audio/video formats, including audio-only HLS
- no native subtitles for the tested video

So Summarize likely does not need a bespoke Loom transcript API path. The more robust implementation is to treat Loom share/embed URLs as media-like URLs and route them through the existing generic `yt-dlp` + transcription pipeline.

## Proposed implementation

Add Loom URL detection for:

- `https://www.loom.com/share/<id>`
- `https://www.loom.com/embed/<id>`

Then:

1. Include Loom in URL-mode preference.
2. In the generic transcript provider, treat Loom as a known media host.
3. Trigger `fetchDirectMediaTranscript(...)` for Loom URLs even in auto mode.
4. Pass `mediaKind: "video"` so the existing `yt-dlp` transcription path can handle it.

This reuses the existing media cache and transcription provider chain instead of adding Loom-specific download/transcription code.

## Local proof of concept

I tested a local patch that does this:

- `packages/core/src/content/url.ts`
  - added `isLoomVideoUrl(...)`
  - included Loom in `shouldPreferUrlMode(...)`
- `packages/core/src/content/transcript/providers/generic.ts`
  - detects Loom URLs
  - routes them to `fetchDirectMediaTranscript(...)`
  - passes `mediaKind: "video"`
- Added focused tests:
  - `tests/content.url.test.ts`
  - `tests/transcript.generic.video-tag.test.ts`
- Updated docs:
  - `docs/media.md`
  - `docs/extract-only.md`
  - `docs/transcript-provider-flow.md`

Validation passed locally:

```bash
pnpm -s test tests/content.url.test.ts tests/transcript.generic.video-tag.test.ts
pnpm -s format:check
pnpm -s typecheck
pnpm -s build
pnpm -s lint
```

## Acceptance criteria

- `summarize <loom-share-url> --extract` can return a transcript when `yt-dlp` and a transcription provider are configured.
- `summarize <loom-share-url> --extract --json` reports transcript metadata from the existing generic media/yt-dlp path.
- Loom URLs do not fall through to `generic/not_implemented` when transcription dependencies are available.
- Private or access-restricted Loom videos fail with the existing useful `yt-dlp`/provider error messages rather than silent page-summary extraction.

## Notes

This depends on `yt-dlp` continuing to support Loom. That seems preferable to scraping Loom internals directly because `yt-dlp` already maintains the extractor and handles Loom's media URL resolution.
